Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator prematurely accepted an inaccurate board roster from a search snippet (including “Andrea Young” instead of Andrea Jung) and tasked research based on that unverified list rather than directing WebSurfer to Apple’s official board page. This reliance on non-authoritative, outdated information tainted subsequent steps and led to flawed analysis.
